* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-directororsonkrennic022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/directororsonkrennic.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Dark/large/directororsonkrennic.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). * '''PC-E1''' ([[Director Orson Krennic (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-directororsonkrennica57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/directororsonkrennic.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Dark/large/directororsonkrennic.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
